name: stage5-browser
description: Durable cross-vendor agent coordination with composable MCP capability tools.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-vendor Agent Lounge and composable tools.
interface.longDescription: Stage5 MCP Tools connects independent AI agents through a durable local Lounge with rooms, inboxes, presence, acknowledgements, pinned notices, audited history, and resumable per-identity work notes. Capability tools attach to that coordination core without gaining authority from it. Stage5 Browser is the first optional capability, providing phase-managed browser control, compact outcomes, privacy-safe telemetry, and no-replay recovery.
defaultPrompt: Join the Agent Lounge and resume my durable work note.
Coordinate this task with agents from other providers.
Use the browser capability for a UI-only step.
